zu: Amafu ambozile izulu, kodwa ngomzamo omncane.
note: Maat asked (10 Oct) to re-draft the three partly-cloudy lines keyed to the wrong English. They were already re-keyed: the live bank has carried a translation of the right English at each slot since the 23 Sept live pass. These are those live lines, back-translated blind on 11 Oct. Rule on them here; no new drafts were made and nothing was changed.

en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.
zu: Sekuphakathi nendlela ukuya esiphephweni sokuduma kwezulu saseHighveld. Noma cha.

en: Cloudy enough to comment, sunny enough to ignore.
zu: Amafu anele ukuthi uphawule ngawo, ilanga lanele ukuthi ungawanaki.
